$Comment: Blightbloom, the Poison Focus's signature: a Poison hit (where the Poison damage line counts) that kills its foe (a hit leaving it under half a percent of its health, as a killing hit does) poisons up to 3 other foes within 3 blocks of it with the game's Poison_T1 at half its damage (DamageMultiplier 0.5, times the proc's strength: about 9 Poison over 16 seconds before your bonuses), yours, so a kill it lands is yours, at most once every 8 seconds. A poison is no control, so it lands on a boss or an elite too. Opens on the Signature step while the Poison Focus is sworn. Retune or switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/procs.json.
